lines: Mere ham-nafas, mere ham-nawa
couplets.en: You share my breath and my song.

lines: Mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de
couplets.en: Do not betray me in the guise of friendship.

lines: Mere ham-nafas, mere ham-nawa
couplets.en: You share my breath and my song.

lines: Mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de
couplets.en: Do not betray me in the guise of friendship.

lines: Main hoon dard-e-ishq se jaan-ba-lab
couplets.en: The pain of love has brought me to my last breath.

lines: Mujhe zindagi ki dua na de
couplets.en: Do not pray that I live.

lines: Mere dagh-e-dil se hai roshni, isi roshni se hai zindagi
couplets.en: My wounded heart gives light, and by that light I live.

lines: Mujhe dar hai, ai mere chara-gar
couplets.en: I am afraid, my healer.

lines: Ye charagh tu hi bujha na de
couplets.en: You may be the one to put out this lamp.
